title: Growth-brain and persona-review cron results are never delivered ('unknown platform webui')
evidence: cron/jobs.json: tc-growth-harness-brain (43b0d5c4446d, hourly) and tc-weekly-persona-review (8d3ac21799d5, Mon 09:00) both report last_status=delivery_failed. The overnight watchdog logged the same thing twice: "result not delivered — unknown platform 'webui'". Every hourly growth report and the weekly persona review are therefore written to disk and thrown away.

notes.note: 2026-09-19 21:3x UTC ops-triage re-verified. Still broken and now confirmed mechanically: gateway/config.py Platform has 25 members (LOCAL, TELEGRAM, DISCORD, ... EMAIL, HOMEASSISTANT, ...) and NO webui member, so deliver=origin with origin.platform=webui can never resolve -- the report is written to cron/output/<job-id>/*.md and then dropped. jobs.json: tc-growth-harness-brain (hourly) and tc-weekly-persona-review (Mon 09:00) both last_status=delivery_failed, and tc-ops-triage (this fix loop) is in the same state -- verified last_status=delivery_failed, last_delivery_error unknown platform webui, last run 17:05. So this loop own reports are discarded too; the board under ops/board/ is the only durable record of what it found. The ONE job that reports ok is tc-overnight-watchdog, which uses deliver=local -- that flips the status to ok while still delivering nothing to Tim, so it hides the failure rather than fixing it and is rejected as a fix. channel_directory.json lists homeassistant and email with EMPTY channel lists and config.yaml has no platforms block, so this profile currently has no messaging destination at all. BLOCKED ON TIM: name a destination (add an email/telegram channel, or accept bot-chat knowing each delivery injects the report as a message the bot answers = an extra agent turn per hour). Fix is one command per job once named, e.g. hermes cron edit 43b0d5c4446d --deliver <target>, plus a gateway restart to pick up jobs.json.

Re-verified 2026-09-19 23:5xZ against ~/.hermes/profiles/turbo-carnival/cron/jobs.json: ALL FOUR turbo-carnival jobs fail delivery -- tc-growth-harness-brain (deliver=origin, last_status=delivery_failed), tc-weekly-persona-review (origin, delivery_failed), tc-ops-triage (origin, delivery_failed), tc-overnight-watchdog (deliver=local, last_status=ok 16:01). So the failure is exactly deliver=origin resolving to platform 'webui', which the gateway cannot deliver to, while 'local' succeeds. One-line fix per job: hermes cron edit <id> --deliver <target> with a target the gateway serves (local writes the report to the profile cron/output/, where it is already being read; telegram or similar if Tim wants a push). NOT ACTIONED: cron config is outside this repo and the destination is Tim's call -- note this run's own report is subject to the same failure, which is why it is escalated instead of worked around.

So this triage run report reaches nobody through cron: the board files and the git commits are the only durable channel. Tim: set deliver=local (or name a real target) for those three jobs.

2026-09-20 04:5xZ ops-triage: diagnosed further -- this is NOT a turbo-carnival config error and there is no working chat target to point at, so it stays a human decision. The three failing jobs (tc-growth-harness-brain, tc-weekly-persona-review, tc-ops-triage) are deliver=origin with origin={\"platform\": \"webui\", \"chat_id\": b5fec27f2fa1 / b42cbe0fbc72} -- i.e. they were created from a WebUI chat and want to deliver BACK INTO that chat. The delivery layer rejects the platform NAME ('unknown platform webui'), it is not a stale chat id. Only tc-overnight-watchdog works, and only because it is deliver=local. hermes cron doctor flags exactly these three. Workarounds and their costs: (a) --deliver local makes the error go away but delivers to nobody (result stays in ~/.hermes/profiles/turbo-carnival/cron/output/<job>/<ts>.md, which is what the triage agent reads) -- this would also HIDE the failure rather than fix it; (b) telegram/discord/slack are all unconfigured for this profile (auth.json holds only LLM provider credentials: copilot/custom:max395/gemini/huggingface/openrouter), so pointing the jobs there fails with 'platform not configured'; (c) the real fix is upstream: register/support the webui platform as a cron delivery target in Hermes, or configure a chat platform for this profile. Not changed here: the destination of Tim's reports is his call and the correct destination is a WebUI chat, which I cannot test from a cron tick.
